question: In fdot-aadt-us19-sr55-pasco-hernando.csv, define each segment's length as END_POST minus BEGIN_POST. Compute the length-weighted mean AADT (sum of AADT x length divided by sum of length) separately for COUNTY Pasco and COUNTY Hernando. What is Pasco minus Hernando, rounded to the nearest whole number?
solve_py:
import os,pandas as pd
D=os.environ.get('DATA_DIR','/app/data')
d=pd.read_csv(D+'/fdot-aadt-us19-sr55-pasco-hernando.csv')
d['L']=d.END_POST-d.BEGIN_POST
w=lambda c:(d[d.COUNTY==c].AADT*d[d.COUNTY==c].L).sum()/d[d.COUNTY==c].L.sum()
print(round(float(w('Pasco')-w('Hernando'))))
